title: P5: audit of promotions/coupons and execution of corrections

sections.title: Verdict and authority
sections.text:
Initial independent audit of baseline fc3d594: RED (4 Major, 1 Minor). One audit of P5.1–P5.8, implemented by other sessions; no subagents. Owner explicitly extended the request: «и ты же исполняешь его, потом коммит и пуш». Product repairs and verification are authorized after the audit. Historical item results/checks are preserved; new corrections and evidence belong to this audit and phase notes.

All five findings repaired; final correction verification GREEN within P5, no open findings. This GREEN is the executor’s verification, not a second independent review of its own product diff. A5 was confirmed at the original SPI guard while checking the public pipeline/usage boundary after A1–A4 repairs.

sections.title: Confirmed findings and owners
sections.text:
A1 — Major — Line discounts ignore the remaining order net. Owning item P5.6. Baseline packages/promotions/src/Evaluation/Internal/DiscountGuard.php:86 returns lineNet only. Order discount 90 followed by a line discount 100 on a 100 quote (and on two 100 lines) reaches totals with order shares larger than the remaining items; QuoteFailed(totals, negative_total), contrary to PRM-05 (docs/architecture/invariants.md:28).

A2 — Major — Current-version stored rules bypass validation. Owning item P5.2; consumers P5.6/P5.7. Baseline packages/promotions/src/Rules/Internal/RuleCodec.php:115–116 loads stored parameters as-is. line.percent_off missing/out-of-range rate fails the entire quote; an extra parameter is silently ignored and the damaged promotion discounts the quote. The documented fail-closed storage boundary is bypassed and reconcile reports such a rule as supported.

A3 — Minor — Budget comparisons overflow for valid Money values. Owning items P5.6/P5.7. Baseline PromotionEngine.php:84 adds spent+total before comparing; DatabasePromotionUsage.php:327 adds spent_minor+discount in the SQL predicate. Valid budget PHP_INT_MAX, spent=PHP_INT_MAX−50, discount=100 minor yields a quote failure (empty verdicts) and SQLSTATE22003 instead of budget_exhausted/UsageLimitReached(budget).

A4 — Major — Generation rounds can deadlock on earlier uncommitted inserts. Owning item P5.5. Baseline packages/promotions/src/Coupons/Internal/DatabaseCoupons.php:244–245 loops insertCodes; its sort at :274 covers one round only. Reproduced with two public generate calls, alphabet ABCD, pattern X-####, count2, preexisting CCCC/DDDD. First rounds insert AAAA/BBBB; next rounds request each other’s code. PostgreSQL detects SQLSTATE40P01. The test forces randomness only inside forked workers, retaining the real API/transactions/SQL.

All eight new regression cases failed before product repairs (exit2), evidence audits/promotions/2026-10-09-p5/regressions-before.txt.

A5 — Major — Code activation is coupled to an owned coupon, making code-based third-party activators unusable at placement. Owning item P5.6 (SPI boundary with P5.7). Baseline packages/promotions/src/Evaluation/Internal/ActivePromotions.php:333 rejects Activation(presentedCode: EXTERNAL, couponCode: null), although public Activation accepts it and the SPI promises a referral link as an extension. Setting couponCode=EXTERNAL instead lets quoting succeed but PromotionUsage then requires a local coupon; Coupons::create refuses promotions whose activator is not coupon. The regression through the real pipeline/port fails at promotions.catalog with InvalidRuleResult before the correction (activator-before.txt, exit2); corrected pipeline/consume/limit rejection/restore/reconcile passes (activator-after.txt). Baseline code has the same guard; A1–A4 repairs do not affect it.

Status: A1–A5 fixed; corrections below and regression evidence prove the affected behavior. The baseline’s historical P5 check results are not replaced with these new outcomes.

sections.title: Required corrections
sections.text:
A1: cap each line discount by both its own line net and the remaining order net, preserving existing order adjustments and the D23 allocation at settlement. A2: validate stored rules against their promotion stage/currency after any upgrade; invalid config becomes unsupported, shared by evaluation and reconcile. A3: compare discount against budget−spent in PHP and SQL. A4: serialize coupon code creation across all generation rounds with one transaction advisory key scoped to the physical coupons table; take it before promotion/receipt locks, including single-code creation. Record the administrative-write throughput tradeoff; placement, restore and readers do not acquire it.

A5: retain couponCode for owned coupons and allow presentedCode alone for a third-party activation code. Refusals use presentedCode independently of couponCode. The quote folds such a promotion with a null couponCode, so the existing port enforces its promotion/customer limits and budget without a fake local coupon. No exported signatures or wire formats changed. Plugins remain responsible for consuming their own external resources.

P5 remains closed (8/8); all corrections completed. Next semantic step: task:plan-design 2026.10.08-№1-COMMERZ-FOUNDATION P6. Commit/push of this task’s full diff explicitly authorized by the owner; initial worktree clean, fetched origin/main equal to baseline fc3d594.

sections.title: Execution and architectural decisions
sections.text:
A1: DiscountGuard::lineLeft caps at min(lineNet, OrderNet::of(state)); each successive discount sees the updated scratch state. Existing line discount bases and public contracts remain the same; D23 reallocates declared order discounts over final line nets. Regressions cover one and two lines after an order discount.

A2: internal RuleCodec::decode now takes RuleScope; stage membership and normalize are checked for current and upgraded versions. ActivePromotions and UsageReconciler pass the promotion stage and currency from existing row reads, with no extra query. InvalidRuleConfig becomes unsupported; healthy promotions still apply. Tests cover missing, out-of-range, extra parameters, unsupported stages and currencies as well as the prior upgrade paths.

A3: budget predicates use discount <= budget−spent in PHP and SQL; SET only adds for a qualifying row. Valid maximum int64 Money amounts now produce ordinary budget refusals and leave no redemption/counter changes on failure.

A4: create/generate take one pg_advisory_xact_lock keyed by commerz.coupon_codes:<physical coupons table> before promotion/receipt locks. It persists across all rounds and until the outer transaction ends. Codes are unique across promotions, so independent per-promotion locks would not protect the namespace. Serializing rare administrative code creation is the deliberate tradeoff, documented in invariants/api and promotions-design#writes. Placement/restore/readers and coupon status/limit mutations do not acquire this lock. The deterministic two-process cross-round regression now creates both complete batches; existing concurrent batch and receipt tests pass.

A5: Activation already permits presentedCode with null couponCode. ActivePromotions now accepts that shape; PromotionEngine emits refusal by presentedCode independently of couponCode. couponCode retains its owned-coupon meaning; an external code requires no local coupon to consume. The regression uses the real pipeline and real PromotionUsage, checks budget/limit counters, the next quote’s code rejection, restore and reconcile. Public signatures and stored formats are unchanged. The plugin consumes any resource of its own.

Contract corrections are recorded through plan.py in promotions-design, with audit references and phase notes. Architecture docs and ACTIVE are synchronized. No independent review loop or next-phase work was added.

sections.title: Coverage and limits
sections.text:
Compared phase P5 and items P5.1–P5.8, recorded validations/deliverables and decisions D25–D27 with product additions de83490..fc3d594: the QuoteResult fold; package configuration/provider/plugin kinds/schema ownership; all built-in conditions/effects and BXGY pooling; RuleParams/codec/SPI trust; promotion definition lifecycle/channel/rule mutations and counter recomputation; coupon canonicalization/generation/receipts/activation; session lifecycle, deterministic stacking, guards, explain; consumption/restoration bookkeeping and lock ordering; reconcile; golden/unit/feature/concurrency/scenario tests and architecture docs. Existing P5 recorded checks already passed and were not repeated before changed-input regressions.

Validation uses PHP8.4.26 and PostgreSQL17 via the project compose service on 127.0.0.1:54329, resolved database=commerz_test. PackageTestCase rejects non-testing or non-_test targets before migration. Serial fixtures and forked committed-data concurrency tests ran sequentially on that isolated DB. No production-scale throughput, alternate database/runtime versions, or P6–P8 implementations are claimed. Concurrency regression random_int is shadowed only inside forked test workers, leaving the parent suite/production generator unchanged.
